description: Elixir escapes a remote capture (&Kernel.+/2) as itself and accepts it as a struct default. Start by finding whether an fz capture value keeps its module, name and arity at run time; then escape it and drop the refusal Macro.escape gives it. Deferred from fz-sc8.144 with the user's approval.
title: Macro.escape writes a remote capture as &M.f/a
